title: HyTown Hang Dong - Mae Hia
description: Hytown Hang Dong - Mae Hia is a modern residential development strategically positioned to offer a blend of convenience and community in Chiang Mai. The master plan reveals a structured layout divided into three main blocks (A, B, and C) comprising 19 units, supported by essential facilities including dedicated security, professional gardening services, and organized waste management. Its location is a significant draw for families and frequent travelers, as it sits within close proximity to prestigious educational institutions like Panyaden and Chiang Mai Montessori, as well as major shopping hubs such as Kad Farang Village, Makro, and Central Chiangmai Airport. Furthermore, with the Chiang Mai International Airport and several top-tier hospitals like Klaimor and Prompt Health Center just a short drive away, the project balances quiet residential living with immediate access to the city’s primary healthcare and transit infrastructure.
